name: The Grand Escape
description: ~550 km road bikepacking. 3-5 days, 100% paved. B&Bs and hotels available.
tips: You won't need a tent or sleeping bag — there are B&Bs and hotels along the entire route.
Pack light! Most TGE riders carry 5-7 kg of gear.
A handlebar + frame + saddle bag setup is all you need.

name: Tuscany Trail
description: ~440 km gravel. Mix of gravel roads and tarmac through Tuscan hills. Bivouac possible.
tips: Many riders bivouac on the Tuscany Trail — a lightweight sleeping bag makes a big difference.
Gravel is harder on tires — bring a complete repair kit including tubeless plugs.
Expect more dirt and sweat — an extra set of clothes is worth the weight.

name: NorthCape4000
description: ~4,000 km from Italy to North Cape. Self-paced ultra over weeks. All weather conditions.
tips: Every gram counts on the NC4000 — but weather changes 10 times a day.
A bigger powerbank (20000mAh) is essential for weeks of riding.
Backup lights are a must — Nordic nights are unpredictable.
Ultra-light is the goal, but don't skip warm layers.

name: Final Frontier Patagonia
description: ~2,700 km gravel through Patagonia. Full self-sufficiency required. Remote terrain.
tips: Patagonia means full self-sufficiency — you need everything including shelter and cooking gear.
Wind is the main challenge. Make sure your bags are secured tightly.
Carry enough food and water capacity for long stretches between resupply points.

name: Unpaved Roads
description: Short 1-2 day gravel weekend events. Minimal gear needed.
tips: This is almost a day ride — pack minimal and enjoy the ride.
Handlebar bag + frame bag is plenty for a weekend.
Focus on repair kit and weather protection.

name: Weekend Trip
description: A short 1-2 day ride. Light packing, focus on essentials.
tips: Keep it light — you'll thank yourself on the climbs.
Focus on essentials: repair kit, rain jacket, snacks.

name: Multi-Day Road
description: 3-7 day road bikepacking. Hotels and shops available for resupply.
tips: On paved roads, you'll find accommodation and food easily.
Focus on keeping weight low for faster, more enjoyable riding.

name: Multi-Day Gravel
description: 3-7 day gravel adventure. May need bivouac gear depending on route.
tips: Gravel means more tire issues — bring a solid repair kit.
Consider a sleeping bag if your route has limited accommodation.

name: Ultra-Distance
description: 1000+ km self-supported. Ultra-light but prepared for all conditions.
tips: Every gram counts. Be ruthless about what you pack.
Bigger powerbank is essential for multi-day charging.

name: Expedition
description: Remote, multi-week, full self-sufficiency. Carry shelter, cooking, all supplies.
tips: Self-sufficiency is key — bring everything you need to survive.
Plan your resupply points carefully.
